info.name: Kit & Sam - Misteri del regno animale
info.plot: Armati di doti investigative, conoscenze scientifiche e strumenti speciali, gli agenti Sam e Kit girano il mondo per risolvere i vari misteri del mondo animale.

translations.value: Kit & Sam - Misteri del regno animale
Armati di doti investigative, conoscenze scientifiche e strumenti speciali, gli agenti Sam e Kit girano il mondo per risolvere i vari misteri del mondo animale.

info.title: Kit & Sam - Misteri del regno animale
info.synopsis: Armati di doti investigative, conoscenze scientifiche e strumenti speciali, gli agenti Sam e Kit girano il mondo per risolvere i vari misteri del mondo animale.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Animal detectives Sam and Kit collect all the clues while searching for the suspect who bit an express train's engineer.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to the African Grasslands to investigate rampaging rhinos at a watering hole gathering, and a bug-loving genet is caught in the act.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Quando la squadra dei topi scompare nella tundra artica, Sam e Kit intraprendono una lunga e tortuosa ricerca e scoprono che, nonostante possa sembrare il contrario, un branco di buoi muschiati nelle vicinanze è probabilmente coinvolto.

translations.value: Quando la squadra dei topi scompare nella tundra artica, Sam e Kit intraprendono una lunga e tortuosa ricerca e scoprono che, nonostante possa sembrare il contrario, un branco di buoi muschiati nelle vicinanze è probabilmente coinvolto.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Sent to the European Wetlands to investigate falling bird eggs, Sam and Kit are given unexpected help from Wally Bungler as they race to stop a sneaky cuckoo bird.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to the African Desert to locate a missing mole rat- the princess of the current kingdom. With time running short, however, the duo have to hurry before a hungry owl finds her first.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to the African Grasslands to help a lost honeybee find her hive and family, with Director Scratch assigning Indy, a nearby field agent, to assist in the search.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Alberi stanno cadendo in modo misterioso nella foresta nordamericana e Sam e Kit devono trovare il colpevole prima che l'intera foresta venga distrutta. Tuttavia, il sospettato sotterraneo è difficile da catturare.

translations.value: Alberi stanno cadendo in modo misterioso nella foresta nordamericana e Sam e Kit devono trovare il colpevole prima che l'intera foresta venga distrutta. Tuttavia, il sospettato sotterraneo è difficile da catturare.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: An orangutan is struck by a thief who has been stealing fruit from her island in the Asian Jungle, but even when Sam and Kit cover all their bases, the mystery bandit keeps slipping by their sights.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit are dispatched to the North American Desert to try and break up a fight between a pair of gila monsters. However, they manage to bite and poison Kit, forcing Sam to work on the case by himself before the lizards leave the town in ruins.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit are sent to find a missing ball of giraffe dung on the African Grasslands. Sam, however, is less than enthused, particularly due to his germophobic nature.

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Wally Bungler joins Kit and Sam in the South American Jungle as they search for a tarantula's pet dotted humming frog. Unfortunately, the surrounding area is full of frogs, and finding the one they're looking for is a real challenge.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: The Mice Squad van's satellite dish is chomped off by a mysterious creature, and both Sam and Kit are at odds at who the culprit is.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: No one's food is safe in the forest when a mysterious thief nabs everyone's supply.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit are on the case when Gordy the giraffe goes missing.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: The Stinkwells send Sam and Kit a strange and crawly case trapped in ice.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: A salamander mom wonders why her dry pond hasn't filled up with water.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Sam tries to blend in with a tough clan of hyenas during a desert mission.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Underground creatures start getting spooked by their burrow's new addition.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: The duo must figure out why bats are suddenly sneezing after waking up from their winter sleep.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Someone's stealing Pierre's "très magnifique" spider webs. It's up to Sam and Kit to follow the clues and crack this itsy-bitsy case wide open.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Kit and Sam are joined by their flying squirrel pal, Wally Bungler, to help locate a missing Arctic fox in the middle of a freezing blizzard.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Something stinks — and for once it isn't the skunks! Sam and Kit travel to South America to uncover the source of a yucky smell.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Three wolves who are new to the forest hear a spooky voice ordering them to go away. Can Sam and Kit uncover who's behind the scares?

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Did Tony the tuatara really eat up that seabird's egg? He's the prime suspect, but maybe there's another explanation for his odd behavior...

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Quando l'acqua minaccia di inondare una spa per il bagno di polvere dei cincillà, Kit e Sam vanno nel deserto per aiutare le creature pelose a stare al sicuro e asciutte.

translations.value: Quando l'acqua minaccia di inondare una spa per il bagno di polvere dei cincillà, Kit e Sam vanno nel deserto per aiutare le creature pelose a stare al sicuro e asciutte.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Animal residents in the North American wetlands are in a panic, claiming their home has been invaded by rats. But Kit and Sam aren't so sure.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: After two birds build their perfect nest, one bird mysteriously goes missing. Is a predator to blame — or is the truth closer to home?

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: When a mysterious orange bat with no memory crash-lands in an African jungle, Sam and Kit offer to help her remember who she is and where she came from.

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: After a velvet worm sticks Sam and Kit together, the two pals must work together to free themselves — and help their new friend get back home.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: On a sunny beach day, a sneaky thief makes off with every drop of milk meant for a group of baby elephant seals. Luckily, Sam and Kit are on the case!

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Sam and Kit try out new glow-in-the-dark goggles to help find a brightly colored creature that causes chaos at a dance party in the African grasslands.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: After swapping sweet Valentine's Day cards, the CLADE crew rushes to help Judy the red panda find her missing special someone before time runs out.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Leonard the lungfish needs to get back to the water — fast. Good thing the CLADE agents are ready to help carry him to safety!

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Dopo che un'eruzione cutanea pruriginosa appare sul Monsoon Express, un uccello pitohui incappucciato aiuta Kit e Sam a interrogare i sospettati nella giungla e a trovare il colpevole.

translations.value: Dopo che un'eruzione cutanea pruriginosa appare sul Monsoon Express, un uccello pitohui incappucciato aiuta Kit e Sam a interrogare i sospettati nella giungla e a trovare il colpevole.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Wally Bungler flies in to help Kit and Sam search for a mysterious creature munching on all the crops in the mountains. Maybe it's the mythical yeti?

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: When a family of dung beetles uncovers an egg that's tumbled out of the nest, the team must find its mother before a hungry goanna lizard gobbles it up.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Philip Night swings by with his son to help Sam and Kit solve a sticky situation when a crafty critter destroys a flock of bird nests.

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: Wally Bungler invites Sam and Kit onto his basement talk show to hear about their first-ever case and how they learned to work together.

translations.title: Kit & Sam - Misteri del regno animale
translations.overview: Armati di doti investigative, conoscenze scientifiche e strumenti speciali, gli agenti Sam e Kit girano il mondo per risolvere i vari misteri del mondo animale.
Special agents Sam and Kit hop the globe with their sleuthing skills, science facts and cool gadgets to solve the animal kingdom's many mysteries.
